# Study Australia

> Official Australian Government portal helping international students discover courses, universities, visas, and career pathways across Australia's world-class education system.

Study Australia serves international students from around the globe with multilingual resources in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Indonesian, Thai, and Vietnamese. The site provides comprehensive guidance on Australian education quality, student visas, living costs, and career planning.

## Key Topics

- International Students
- Student Visa
- Course Search
- Australian Universities
- University Rankings
- Study Planning
- Career Planning
- Living Costs
- IELTS, TOEFL, PTE
- Work-Integrated Learning
- Scholarships
- Student Stories
- Vocational Training
- Research Opportunities
- Multicultural Australia

## Language Portals

- [Study Australia - English](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en): English language homepage for international students exploring Australian education options
- [Study Australia - Chinese](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/zh): Chinese language portal offering course search and student visa information for China
- [Study Australia China - 中文官网](https://china.studyaustralia.gov.au): Dedicated Chinese website for Australian study and career pathway information
- [Study Australia - India](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en_in): India-targeted portal with course search, visa info and living cost guidance
- [Study Australia Japan - 日本語](https://japan.studyaustralia.gov.au): Japanese language portal for Australian study opportunities and career planning
- [Study Australia - Korean](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/ko): Korean language guide covering courses, visas and university rankings in Australia
- [Study Australia - Spanish](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/es): Spanish language guide for course search, visas and living in Australia
- [Study Australia - Portuguese](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/pt): Portuguese language official site for Australian education and student visa guidance
- [Study Australia - Arabic](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/ar): Arabic language official resource for international students studying in Australia
- [Study Australia - Indonesian](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/id): Indonesian language resource for international student course and visa information
- [Study Australia - Thai](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/th): Thai language resource for international students exploring Australian study options
- [Study Australia - Vietnamese](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/vi): Vietnamese language guide for Australian study, visas and university information

## Why Study in Australia

- [Why Australia](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/why-australia): Overview of Australia's education quality, culture and student experience benefits
- [World Class Education](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/why-australia/world-class-education): Guide to Australia's top-ranked universities and globally valued qualifications
- [World-Leading Research](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/why-australia/world-leading-research): Overview of Australia's research innovations and graduate research opportunities
- [Real World Learning](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/why-australia/real-world-learning): Guide to practical, industry-relevant Australian education and work-integrated learning
- [Australian Culture and Lifestyle](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/why-australia/australian-culture-and-lifestyle): Information on multicultural communities, safety and quality of life in Australia

## Plan Your Studies

- [Plan Your Studies](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-studies): Guide to Australian education institutions including universities and vocational training
- [Find a Course](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au/en/plan-your-studies/find-a-course): Course search tool to explore programs, providers and scholarships in Australia

## Home

- [Study Australia Home](https://www.studyaustralia.gov.au): Official Australian Government portal for international students seeking courses and scholarships
